# Vendored browser libraries

These files are served locally so the control center works offline and under a
strict Content-Security-Policy.

| File | Project | Version | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| `marked.min.js` | [marked](https://github.com/markedjs/marked) | 15.0.7 | MIT |
| `purify.min.js` | [DOMPurify](https://github.com/cure53/DOMPurify) | 3.2.4 | Apache-2.0 / MPL-2.0 |
| `highlight.min.js`, `highlight.css` | [highlight.js](https://github.com/highlightjs/highlight.js) | 11.11.1 | BSD-3-Clause |

Upstream license texts and source are available at the linked projects.
